title: The Smoking Mountain
text: The mountain ahead is smoking, its slopes black and cracked, the air thick with sulphur. The dragons nest in its warmth: you can see their shapes on the ledges. The path goes over its shoulder, right past them.

options.label: Go over the shoulder, past the nests.

outcomes.text: Over, choking on ash, with every kit black with it.
A dragon's nest on the path, and the dragon in it.

options.label: The sharpest eye finds the old lava tubes.

outcomes.text: Through the mountain's belly, in the hot dark, and out the far side with pockets full of glowing stone.
Days lost, and the smoke on the horizon the whole time, watching.
